intro: Welcome guests, upgrade rooms, hire staff and build the hotel empire of your dreams!
description:
Welcome to Hotel Tycoon, a fun and relaxing hotel management game where every happy guest brings you closer to building the ultimate hotel empire!

Start with a small hotel and transform it into a thriving business. Clean rooms, welcome new guests, collect money, upgrade furniture, unlock stylish decorations and expand your hotel floor by floor.

Hire helpful employees to speed up your business, improve every room and keep your guests satisfied while your hotel grows bigger than ever.

Unlock new character skins with unique bonuses to customize your manager and improve your gameplay.

Meet all kinds of funny visitors along the way. Most guests are ordinary travelers, but don't be surprised when strange visitors check in too. Skeletons, aliens and other unexpected characters can appear and make every session more entertaining.

Once you've mastered your first hotel, move on to an even bigger location with new opportunities and continue growing your hospitality empire.

Whether you enjoy relaxing simulation games, casual tycoon experiences or management games, Hotel Tycoon offers several hours of satisfying progression that's easy to learn and rewarding to master.

Features

• Build and manage your own hotel

• Clean rooms and prepare them for new guests

• Welcome a variety of visitors

• Upgrade rooms with better furniture

• Expand your hotel with new areas

• Hire employees to automate your business

• Unlock character skins with unique bonuses

• Earn money and grow your hotel empire

• Discover funny special guests including skeletons and aliens

• Unlock a second hotel with new challenges

Become the ultimate Hotel Tycoon!
